real: BMD-4M (Bakhcha-U turret: 2A70 100 mm, 2A72 30 mm coaxial, PKT; two bow PKT)
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p25_new / mb_p27_wave3): light airborne IFV, BMD-4 look, extruded hull and turret, the 100 mm gun and the coaxial gun; 5.0 x 2.5 x 2.0 m (about 0.8 x the real BMD-4M); team bands on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the small boat hull (Team) with the sharp double-sloped beak
the trim vane folded on the glacis, its ribs and arms
the driver's hatch and periscopes; the two bow machine guns in ball mounts
five road wheels, rear sprocket, front idler on its arm, four return rollers, a linked track
thin fender skirts over the track tops with mud flaps
engine deck grilles, the rear hatch, the two water-jet outlets, the exhaust louvre
the faceted Bakhcha-U turret, its cheek plates
the mantlet with the 100 mm gun, the 30 mm coaxial cannon and its jacket, the PKT
the gunner's sight head (right), the commander's panoramic sight on its post (left), two hatches
the rear stowage box, bags, a canvas roll, jerrycans, tow cable, lamps, hooks, whips, Team bands
